notes: The Admin Console's section index at rest (#974, #1627, ADR-0193). `origin` is the title, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gaps between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the first section card, the region both clients draw identically. The at-rest state needs an admin session, so a re-recording needs the gate's fixture account named in the deployment's `ADMIN_EMAILS`; the allowlist is the deployment's, and a spec must not grant it. Widths of a label's own words are left out deliberately: they are the run of the text, not a decision. The reports card's `top` is left out for the same reason it is measured at the far end of the list: every card above it is one sentence wrapping to one or two lines, so the sum is the run of ten sentences rather than the card design. Its width, height and radius are measured so the card family still has a second witness. Colours are left out too, because they are what the raster proves.

motion.notes: The index is still. A card dims its border and background on hover; the same means the same 150ms colour transition, with no travel and no layout change. The section arrow would travel 4px on hover on the page and is not drawn as motion in the app yet.
